summary.text: Raging Emotion is a killer move a dream-realm disciple created. Meng Qiu Zhen knows of it while exploring that dream.

claims.text: Meng Qiu Zhen explores a dream realm inside the sovereign immortal aperture. In the final scene, after the master and disciple turn on each other, he interrupts so the disciple cannot call him master for the last time. Meng Qiu Zhen wanted that outcome. He understood this disciple, who had created his own raging emotion killer move. To Meng Qiu Zhen the move was incredible: it could use wisdom path to allow all sorts of emotions to surge in power. If the disciple managed to say it, he would feel a sense of freedom and would be able to use the killer move freely. Meng Qiu Zhen judges that once the disciple activated raging emotion, he would gain a huge advantage in this dream realm, and that Meng Qiu Zhen would face great difficulty trying to pass it. The battle progresses as Meng Qiu Zhen predicted. He keeps attacking and does not give the disciple a chance to talk. The disciple is constantly suppressed and, without a choice, has to give up on his strongest raging emotion killer move and use the nine-nine multiplication table method instead.
